LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Jade.label: jade tiles
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Jade.description: Polished green stone tiles set in a pattern of interlocking clouds.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_GreyBrick.label: grey brick paving
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_GreyBrick.description: Fired grey bricks laid in a herringbone. Granary yards and city streets of Tianxia are paved with them.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Lacquer.label: red lacquer boards
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Lacquer.description: Boards coated in many layers of red lacquer until they shine like glass. Only halls of state and rich houses can afford them.
